name: KJMC Corporate Advisors (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1998, KJMC Corporate Advisors LTD is in the business of providing Corporate Advisory, Financial Advisory, Equity Valuation and Investment Banking services.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
KJMCCAIL is registered as a Category-I Merchant Banker with SEBI and is in the business of providing financial advisory services, investment banking, securities trading, and other related activities.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.28 times its book value
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 215 days to 140 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 2.21% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.0.75 Cr.
